title: Closing: date, interviewers and Tio's sisters
summary: Russell states the date October 26, 1960, the interview team (Russell, Ralph Collins, Harold Dejan), and checks the names of Tio's sisters Alice Long and Josephine.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Well this is just about out here, about a half a minute. I don't believe there's anything else to do. I think you have to ask, but I'll mention on here too that the date is October 26, 1960, and we're at Mr. T. O.'s home. It's 24, 24 London. That's right. And the other members of the interviewing team here, my name is Bill Russell of course, and Ralph Collins is here, and Mr. Harold Dajon is helping us out very kindly tonight too. And that was Mrs. Long. My first name is Isabella, is that?
Alice T. O. Long. Now there was another one of your sisters you mentioned before I got the names mixed up.
Josephine. Gaspard. Oh yes. So I think everything is in order, and we'll just turn it off and there it goes.
